items: Things standing in front of the witch fade right away round her, over a wider, softer circle
The canopy cut-away round her is smaller again, her light reaching as far as ever
Shadows take the full colour opposite to the light they lie in
The pause page has a Low mist slider to make the mist stronger
The pause page no longer lists the circle hunt's test switches; the canopy cut-away's size slider and the Circle report stay
